# Marketics

> Marketics, LLC (marketics.io): performance-based short-term rental (STR) optimization for Airbnb and VRBO hosts. A documented 45% median revenue lift, net of market, across 19 documented engagements; a decade of work across 1,000+ listings in 22 markets; every property is audited individually before a target is set. 10% of net payout, no monthly fee, no contract.

Marketics is a performance-based short-term rental optimization company that combines dynamic pricing, listing optimization, automated guest communication, market analytics, and marketing into a managed offering for Airbnb and VRBO hosts. Founded in 2023 by Jason Baxter, a 35× Airbnb Superhost with 10+ years in the vacation rental industry and 1,000+ properties optimized across North America. Headquarters: 1000 Brickell Avenue, Suite 715, Miami, FL 33131. Service area: United States, Canada, Mexico.

## Markets

Marketics optimizes in any market across the United States, Canada, and Mexico; the market is the variable, the method is the constant. Its footprint spans 1,000+ listings across 22 markets to date. San Antonio is the first market with a full dedicated read; other markets are covered through the market-intelligence reports above and the free, property-specific audit.

- [All markets](https://marketics.io/markets): How Marketics reads any STR market — the market is the variable, the method is the constant.
- [San Antonio, TX](https://marketics.io/markets/san-antonio): San Antonio short-term rental revenue optimization — demand rhythm, Type 2 density caps (12.5% per block face), and what an optimized listing earns.

## What Marketics Does

A fully managed revenue optimization service for short-term rental owners and property managers:

- **Dynamic pricing optimization**: rate management calibrated to local demand, events, seasonality, and competitor positioning to maximize RevPAR (revenue per available room).
- **Listing creation and optimization**: professional copy, photography guidance, and platform SEO for Airbnb, VRBO, and direct booking channels.
- **Automated guest communication**: templated and AI-assisted messaging for pre-arrival, mid-stay, and post-checkout.
- **Market analysis**: pre-investment analytics, comp analysis, event-demand mapping, and market selection guidance.
- **Marketing services**: Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn, and direct booking funnels for portfolios scaling up.

## Pricing & Refund

Marketics charges 10% of net payout per booking. No fees beyond a one-time **$500 commitment deposit — refunded automatically when you complete the 90-day program**. The only condition is completion; withdrawing before Day 90 forfeits the deposit. No monthly retainers, no long-term contracts. The model is performance-based: Marketics only earns when the host earns.

## Key Results (Methodology)

All statistics reflect Marketics-managed properties. Sample: 19 documented short-term-rental engagements, measured 2019–2026. Median net-of-market revenue lift: 45% (range −3% to +193%). Inclusion: Includes every documented client engagement where the property was already operating as a short-term rental at intake and revenue records (PMS exports) are on file. Results are measured net of same-market, same-period movement. Long-term-rental conversions and engagements without verifiable records are excluded.

- The benchmark is a 45% median revenue lift, net of market, set at the median of 19 documented short-term-rental engagements. Results are property-specific, so every property is audited individually before a target is set; we don't quote a number on a listing we haven't seen. Because the fee is 10% of net payout with no monthly fee, the large majority of any gain stays with the host.
- Full distribution and methodology: [the Marketics STR Performance Index](https://marketics.io/intel/str-performance-index).
- Average time to measurable results: 72 days from audit completion.
- Average guest rating post-optimization: 4.93★ (up from ~4.3 before).

## About the Founder

Jason Baxter is a 35× Airbnb Superhost and the founder of Marketics. He has built, managed, and optimized 1,000+ short-term rental listings across North America over the past decade, combining hands-on hosting experience with data-driven pricing strategy, platform-algorithm expertise, and marketing automation. Jason is based in Montréal, Québec; Marketics is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and serves short-term rental owners across the United States.
